findings.issue: The docstring says 'This is the zero count of a real Cauchy–Riemann operator on a line bundle, for any regularity in which the similarity principle supplies the factorization.' The theorems only bound the number of zeros by ⟨e(E),[M]⟩ (and give finiteness, nonnegativity and vanishing). They do not show the orders sum to the Euler number, and they involve no operator and no weak regularity.

summary: The new theorem docstrings are accurate, but the Holomorphic module docstring cites the new vanishing theorem by an unqualified name and calls the results the full zero count of a Cauchy–Riemann operator at any regularity, which is more than the statements give.
